content: {"praised":["Engaging bilingual mystery with tense, intriguing plot.","Strong chemistry between English and French detectives.","Well-acted performances, especially female detective.","Better than original Swedish series.","Absorbing thriller with clear body‑split premise."],"criticized":["Plot feels disappointing and uninteresting.","Confusing language mix, hard to understand French protagonist.","Story boils down to simple revenge.","Poor pacing, lost interest after three episodes.","Lack of depth beyond twist ending."]}
